climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: Wisconsin's first AVA, in Columbia and Dane counties, with the Wisconsin River and Lake Wisconsin on its borders. Most vines sit.
